title: Hypoxic mesenchymal stem cell-Derived Exosomal circPTP4A2 improves granulosa cell mitochondrial function via YBX1.
authors: Zhu, Xiaolan; Shi, Xuyan; Lu, Jingjing; Li, Wenxin; Liu, Yueqin; Jiang, Lin; Lv, Yanting
journal: Cellular and molecular life sciences : CMLS
one_liner_zh: 该文研究缺氧MSC外泌体circPTP4A2通过YBX1改善颗粒细胞线粒体功能，虽涉及分子动力学模拟分析circRNA-蛋白互作，但核心是circRNA-YBX1而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Premature ovarian insufficiency (POI) profoundly compromises female reproductive health through accelerated follicle depletion and endocrine disruption. Emerging evidence highlights the therapeutic potential of mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes (MSC-Exs), particularly when their function is enhanced by hypoxic preconditioning. In this study, the ability of hypoxia-preconditioned MSC-Exs (H-Exs) to ameliorate oxidative damage to granulosa cells (GCs) and restore ovarian function, was systematically evaluated, and a POI rat model was used to investigate the underlying mechanism. METHODS: CircRNAs specifically expressed in H-Exs were identified and validated. The ability of H-Exs and their corresponding circPTP4A2 to repair oxidative damage and restore mitochondrial function were evaluated by antioxidant enzyme assays, reactive oxygen species (ROS) assays, JC-1 staining, ATP level assays, oxygen consumption rate (OCR) measurements and TEM. The interaction between circPTP4A2 and YBX1 was analysed by molecular dynamics simulations, RIP, CHX assays, and MG132 assays, and the restorative effect of the circPTP4A2/YBX1 axis on ovarian function was verified. RESULTS: Our findings revealed that compared with normoxic MSC-Exs (N-Exs), H-Exs exerted superior protective effects, significantly attenuating oxidative stress and restoring mitochondrial bioenergetics in KGN cells. Mechanistically, circPTP4A2 was identified as a hypoxia-responsive cargo selectively enriched in H-Exs. This circular RNA stabilized Y-box binding protein 1 (YBX1) through direct interaction, increasing its antioxidative capacity and mitochondrial regulatory functions. Hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1alpha) was further shown to transcriptionally upregulate circPTP4A2 via direct binding to the promoter region of its host gene PTP4A2. CONCLUSION: These results establish the circPTP4A2/YBX1 axis as a critical mediator of the therapeutic efficacy of H-Exs for POI, providing both mechanistic insights and a translational framework for exosome-based regenerative strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景：早发性卵巢功能不全（premature ovarian insufficiency, POI）通过加速卵泡耗竭和内分泌紊乱，深刻损害女性生殖健康。新近证据凸显了间充质干细胞来源外泌体（mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes, MSC-Exs）的治疗潜力，尤其是在低氧预处理增强其功能时。本研究系统评估了低氧预处理MSC-Exs（H-Exs）改善颗粒细胞（granulosa cells, GCs）氧化损伤并恢复卵巢功能的能力，并利用POI大鼠模型探讨其潜在机制。方法：鉴定并验证了H-Exs中特异性表达的circRNAs。通过抗氧化酶测定、活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）测定、JC-1染色、ATP水平测定、耗氧率（oxygen consumption rate, OCR）测量和透射电镜（TEM），评估了H-Exs及其相应circPTP4A2修复氧化损伤和恢复线粒体功能的能力。通过分子动力学模拟、RIP、CHX测定和MG132测定分析了circPTP4A2与YBX1之间的相互作用，并验证了circPTP4A2/YBX1轴对卵巢功能的恢复作用。结果：我们的发现表明，与常氧MSC-Exs（N-Exs）相比，H-Exs表现出更优的保护效果，显著减轻KGN细胞中的氧化应激并恢复线粒体生物能量学。机制上，circPTP4A2被鉴定为一种低氧响应性货物，选择性富集于H-Exs中。该环状RNA通过直接相互作用稳定Y-box结合蛋白1（YBX1），增强其抗氧化能力和线粒体调控功能。进一步显示，低氧诱导因子1-α（HIF-1alpha）通过直接结合其宿主基因PTP4A2的启动子区域，转录性上调circPTP4A2。结论：这些结果确立了circPTP4A2/YBX1轴作为H-Exs治疗POI疗效的关键介质，为基于外泌体的再生策略提供了机制见解和转化框架。
